title: MetroPulse: Smart-Card Ridership
context: Metro systems log every card tap at entry and exit gates. Planners study ridership peaks, crowded stretches between stations and fare products.
input: Taps: card id, station index (0..24), time (minutes), entry/exit flag. Fare table as an array.

milestones.title: Busiest station
milestones.requirement: Entries per station with an int array indexed by station; report the busiest.

milestones.title: Cheapest fare products
milestones.requirement: Fewest trip cards (10, 25 and 60 rides) to cover a month’s rides exactly (coin change).

milestones.title: Load on each track segment
milestones.requirement: Each journey occupies segments [from, to): add +k/−k to a difference array, rebuild the load per segment.

milestones.title: Peak 15-minute window
milestones.requirement: Busiest window of entries with a fixed-size sliding window over per-5-minute counts.

milestones.title: Train capacity needed
milestones.requirement: Minimum train capacity so the queued riders, in order, are carried within 4 trips (binary search on the answer, greedy check).

milestones.title: Next busier hour
milestones.requirement: For each hour, how many hours until a busier one (monotonic stack).
